responsibility: Implements gm2’s declaration-context validator as a small stacked set of state flags. It maintains pooled `StateCheck` records, supports push/pop inheritance of the current declaration state, tracks whether parsing is inside CONST/TYPE/VAR blocks or constant-function/constructor contexts, and checks referenced symbols via `SymbolTable.IsType`/`IsConst`/`IsVar`, emitting `M2MetaError` diagnostics when a qualident of the wrong class appears in the current declaration context.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the executable implementation of `M2StateCheck`: it defines the `StateCheck` record and state enum, manages stacked instances with a freelist, and performs symbol-class checks that emit `M2MetaError` diagnostics. Its same-name counterpart `M2StateCheck.def` only exposes the opaque type and procedure signatures to the rest of the gm2 compiler.
